ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my repair supplies, but I do not have a specific metal repair in mind right now.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Super Lube 56204 O-Ring Silicone Lubricant, Clear; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My hose clamp purchases do not establish a need for O-ring lubricant.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Ten tubes feel excessive for my occasional repair needs, despite my previous Gorilla tape purchases.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gorilla Waterproof Caulk & Seal100% Silicone Sealant, 2.8oz Squeeze Tube, Clear (Pack of 1); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A small sealant tube fits my repair interests, but I would wait until I have a sealing job.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld Plastic Bonder Black 25ml Syringe - 2 Pack (50139-2), 25 ml - 2 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My vinyl cement purchase was material-specific; I would need a suitable plastic repair before choosing this.
